introduction: Ryan Tubridy (born 28 May 1973), nicknamed Tubs,[4][5][6] is an Irish broadcaster, a presenter of live shows on radio and television in Ireland. Tubridy is the highest earning presenter on RTÉ.[7][8] He is the current host of long-running TV chat programme The Late Late Show and a weekday morning radio show called The Ryan Tubridy Show.
